title: Chau Doc river and mountain day
summary: Eat bún cá at Chợ Châu Đốc, take a boat among the fish rafts, walk the halls at Núi Sam, and stay on the riverbank from dusk.

stops.name: Chau Doc Market

approach.note: From a river room in phường Châu Đốc.

stops.note: Eat bún cá at the edge of the hall in the morning.

stops.name: Fish-raft village
stops.note: Take a boat among the fish-farm rafts at the river junction.

stops.name: Ba Chua Xu Temple
stops.note: See the statue at the foot of Núi Sam, and come at the start of the day in the fourth lunar month.

stops.name: Tay An Pagoda

approach.note: On the Núi Sam walk with the shrine.

stops.note: See the painted facade and the stupa garden on the same morning as the shrine.

stops.name: Hau riverfront
stops.note: Stay on the town bank from dusk for the barges and the lit rafts.

additions.name: Tra Su cajuput forest
additions.note: Give the flooded forest its own half day, 23 km from town by road.

seoTitle: Chau Doc in a day — market, rafts, Sam Mountain
seoDescription: A Châu Đốc day: bún cá at the market, a boat among the fish rafts, the temples at Núi Sam, and the Hậu bank from dusk.
